{{Top|leg}}
'''Rotorcraft''' were personal transport vehicles produced on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] by [[V'Jar Technologies]]. Although many different models were produced, by the time the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] took over Goroth, nationalization of the company led to the [[Silver Falcon (rotorcraft)|Silver Falcon]] being the only model produced.
